title: Remodeling in Jacó: Homes & Condos | MA Soluciones
description: Remodeling in Jacó for homes, condos and vacation rentals. Bathrooms, kitchens, floors and painting with minimal disruption. Quotes within 48 h.
lead: We remodel homes, condos and vacation villas in Jacó, upgrading kitchens, bathrooms, floors and façades with phased planning that reduces the impact on your routine or your guests.
heroAlt: Interior remodeling in a Jacó condo, Costa Rica
highlightsTitle: Remodeling in Jacó, without the headaches

highlights.title: Rental-ready results
highlights.text: We renovate villas and apartments for guests: durable finishes, modern lighting and updated bathrooms that help reviews and occupancy.

highlights.title: Phased construction
highlights.text: We plan by areas and schedules so the property stays habitable — or the condo keeps operating — during the remodel.

highlights.title: Documented progress
highlights.text: Weekly photo and video updates, with a single point of contact for owners living in San José or abroad.

zoneLinkText: Jacó is the tourist and residential hub of the Central Pacific, between Garabito, Herradura and Playa Hermosa. We serve the area from our local base.

faqs.q: Can you remodel just one bathroom or kitchen?
faqs.a: Yes. We take on partial projects: one bathroom, one kitchen, floors or painting. You can also start with one area and continue later.

faqs.q: How long does a full remodel take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope, but a full home or condo remodel usually takes between 2 weeks and 2 months. We deliver a schedule before starting.

faqs.q: Do you work in condos with house rules?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate with management on working hours, common areas and noise limits, following your building regulations.
